decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the 12 November 2017.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (832 01A, 832 03, 832 01, 832 03A Received: 30 September 2015 Location Plan Received: 21 October 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) and condition 4 to alter the glazed window opening to the internal courtyard following planning permission 00354/99/P7 dated 13/11/2014 for erection of a two storey extension to the outbuilding and a single storey extension linking it to the main house
